subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — Acme Health
messages:
From: Ellen Price <ellen.price@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa@redwood.com, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: SIG/CAIQ after discovery call

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the discovery call today — that was really helpful for scoping around our PHI flows. Per our security team's request, we'd like to kick off the vendor security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) to collect formal evidence. Can you share your standard SIG spreadsheet and the most recent SOC 2 report? Also: a couple quick clarifying items we care about up front so we can triage internally:

- Do you currently hold a SOC 2 Type II report covering security and availability? If yes, what is the coverage period?
- Are you willing to attest to HIPAA Business Associate Agreement terms for PHI handling?
- Where is customer data hosted by default (region/data residency)?

We'd like to target an internal review by April 12th. Please let me know any blockers on your side.

Thanks,

Ellen Price
Security Manager, Acme Health
ellen.price@acmehealth.com
+1-415-555-0198

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Price <ellen.price@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa@redwood.com, jordan@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG/CAIQ after discovery call

Hi Ellen — great speaking earlier, and happy to get this started.

I've attached our standard SIG template (redwood_SIG_template.xlsx) and a stub of our most recent SOC 2 report (redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf). For the record: we have a SOC 2 Type II report covering controls for security and availability for the 12-month period ending 2026-11-30; full attestation is available under NDA — happy to route the full report to security@acmehealth.com if needed.

Quick answers to the items you flagged:
- SOC 2 Type II: Yes (see note above).
- HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA-regulated workloads via our Redwood Private offering and are open to a BAA; our legal team typically signs a standard BAA for customers handling PHI.
- Default hosting / residency: For hosted deployments customer data is stored in the region selected at provisioning (we support us-west, us-east, and eu-west); for Dedicated/Private we can pin to a customer-managed VPC.

Can you confirm whether you prefer us to complete the full SIG or the CAIQ-lite first? Also, do you have any required evidence deadlines aside from the April 12 review?

I copied Marissa (Security & Compliance) and Jordan (Customer Success) to help with evidence and timelines.

Attachments:
- redwood_SIG_template.xlsx (SIG spreadsheet)
- SOC2-report-2024.pdf (summary stub)

Best,

--
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
(555) 555-0123

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: marissa@redwood.com, jordan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Follow-up: SIG/CAIQ after discovery call

Team — forwarding Acme's request. They're aiming for an internal review on 12 Apr. Two quick asks so we can scope effort:

1) Marissa — can you confirm whether we should push the full SIG first or complete a CAIQ-lite? CAIQ-lite would be faster (~2–3 business days) but they'll likely need SOC2 evidence for anything with PHI.
2) Jordan — please confirm estimated time for the evidence pull (data map, encryption, user access controls) and whether we need Legal loop for BAA discussion. If we can get the SOC2 NDA and a signed POA, we can send the full report securely.

I'll propose the following next steps to Acme:
- We return CAIQ-lite + SOC2 summary by EOD Apr 6
- If they want the full SIG we commit to a Jun 1 target (depending on evidence collection)

Comments welcome and I'll send the timeline to Acme once we align.

--
Camila

From: Ellen Price <ellen.price@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG/CAIQ after discovery call

Thanks Camila — that timeline sounds reasonable. A couple of clarifying questions from our security team before we confirm CAIQ-lite vs full SIG: 

1) For SOC 2: can you confirm whether the 2026 Type II report includes monitoring/alerting controls for anomalous access, and whether penetration testing results are included or accompanied by a remediation statement?
2) For HIPAA/BAA: does Redwood require the customer to use Redwood Private to sign a BAA, or will the Hosted API be covered under a BAA as well? We want to understand if any architectural change is required on our side.
3) Data residency: when you say "region selected at provisioning" for hosted, does that include encrypted backups and logs, or do backups/logs sometimes route to a central region?

If you can provide short answers to these three, we can tell leadership whether CAIQ-lite is sufficient or whether we need the full SIG. If possible we need the CAIQ-lite + SOC2 summary by Apr 6 as you suggested.

Best,

Ellen Price
Security Manager, Acme Health
ellen.price@acmehealth.com
